pages.name: Caro-Kann: Advance, 4.Nf3 e6 5.Be2 Nd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 routed Ng3-f5 with no knight on g3; plan 3 sent the knight to c5 (covered by d4) or via f8 (bishop there); plan 4 played Nh2-g4 with no knight on h2. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Advance, 4.Nf3 e6 5.Be2 Nd7
pages.notes: Plan 4 played ...Be7 with the knight on e7 and rerouted a 'g6-knight' where the bishop stands; plan 3 sent the b1-knight (already on d2) to f1 with the rook there; plan 1 said Nxg6 damages Black's structure. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Gurgenidze/Modern: 3.Nd2 g6 4.Ngf3 Bg7
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed d4-d5 into Black's d5-pawn. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Panov Attack, Modern Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d4-d5 into Black's d5-pawn; plan 3 routed ...Nbd7-b6 with the knight on c6; plan 4 routed Nc3-e2-g3. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Panov Attack, Modern Defense, Carlsbad Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d4-d5 into Black's d5-pawn. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Panov Attack, Modern Defense, Mieses Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d4-d5 into Black's d5-pawn. Rewrote plan 1 around 7.cxd5 Nxd5 8.Qb3 (reviewer: first draft rejected as vague, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Panov-Botvinnik, Herzog Defense
pages.notes: Plan 4 routed the knight via b7 with Black's pawn there. Rewrote plan 4 (...b5, ...Nb7, ...Nd6); British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Exchange Variation, Rubinstein, 6...Bg4
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed b2-b4 through the queen on b3 as a 'minority attack'; plan 3 routed the knight via f1-e3 vaguely; plan 4 said ...Bxf3 damages White's structure. Rewrote all four plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Exchange Variation, Rubinstein, 6...Bg4
pages.notes: The overview and plans said ...Bxf3 leaves White with doubled f-pawns and an open g-file, but the d2-knight recaptures. Rewrote overview and all three plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Exchange Variation, Rubinstein, 6...Bg4
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured Nxd6 with no knight able to reach d6; plan 2 traded on d3, which Black can't. Rewrote plans 1 and 2; British spelling.
